description: Step 10 of docs/the-delivery-loop.md: the holdings of a delivered branch released, every gesture safe to run again. The mandate is one JSON object naming the repo, the branch and the issue, with base and forge_repo optional. The proof is the merged pull request of the branch, read from the host so a rerun after the branch is gone still finds it, and the remote trunk must carry both its head and its merge commit before anything is deleted. The closing comment names that commit and passes the publication gate before it leaves; an issue already closed is left as it is. The worktree holding the branch is removed only when it is clean and nobody holds its lock; the local and remote branches are deleted only when the remote trunk carries their tip, and the remote deletion follows the push policy read from the trusted trunk. The run is complete only when the issue reads closed and no worktree, local branch or remote branch is left. Every forge call runs as the account in sailor.forgeAs.

with.command:
set -eu
common=$(cd "$REPO" && cd "$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir)" && pwd)
outgoing="$common/sailor/outgoing"
mkdir -p "$outgoing"
file="$outgoing/closing-issue-$ISSUE.md"
printf 'Closed by %s (pull request #%s), which the remote %s carries.\n' "$COMMIT" "$NUMBER" "$BASE" > "$file"
printf '{"text_file":"%s"}' "$file"

set -eu
tip=$(git -C "$REPO" rev-parse --verify --quiet "refs/heads/$BRANCH^{commit}" || true)
if [ -n "$tip" ]; then
    git -C "$REPO" merge-base --is-ancestor "$tip" "$TRUNK" || { echo "the local $BRANCH at $tip carries commits the remote $BASE does not" >&2; exit 1; }
    git -C "$REPO" branch -D "$BRANCH" >&2
fi
printf '{"deleted":"%s"}' "$tip"

set -eu
cd "$REPO"
said=$(sailor policy) || { echo "the delivery policy could not be resolved from the trusted trunk" >&2; exit 1; }
printf '%s\n' "$said" | python3 -c '
import json, sys
lines = [line.strip() for line in sys.stdin if line.strip()]
fields = dict(line.split(": ", 1) for line in lines[:-1])
for key in ("merge", "push", "release"):
    if fields.get(key) not in ("auto", "ask"):
        sys.exit("the policy does not say auto or ask for " + key)
print(json.dumps({
    "merge": fields["merge"], "push": fields["push"], "release": fields["release"],
    "read_from": lines[-1],
    "asks_publication": "ask" if fields["push"] == "ask" else "auto",
    "asks_integration": "ask" if "ask" in (fields["merge"], fields["push"]) else "auto",
    "asks_release": "ask" if "ask" in (fields["release"], fields["push"]) else "auto",
}))
'

$join: The delivery policy read from the trusted trunk (commit
) asks a person before this flow may delete the remote branch. Approve with an output file holding {"authorized": true}, or reject with the reason.

options.label: authorize
options.facts: every check before this step passed on the recorded commit

options.label: refuse
options.facts: nothing outward has happened yet; the run stops here

with.command:
set -eu
printf '%s' "$SAID" | KEY="$KEY" python3 -c '
import json, os, sys
said = json.loads(sys.stdin.read())
if not isinstance(said, dict) or said.get(os.environ["KEY"]) is not True:
    sys.exit("the person did not write %s: true; nothing proceeds" % os.environ["KEY"])
print(json.dumps({"confirmed": True}))
'
